## Declarations and implementations

```plato

// A stereo camera pair derived from a single template camera
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stereoscopy). The template's pose is the rig
// center; each eye is offset by half of EyeSeparation along the pose's right
// axis (typical human separation is 0.063 meters). ConvergenceDistance is where
// the two view axes cross: the zero-parallax plane.
type StereoCameraRig
    implements IValue
{
    Template: PerspectiveCamera;
    EyeSeparation: Length;
    ConvergenceDistance: Length;
}

//==
// # ICamera optics and output regions
//
// The lens-side and image-side companions of the camera types in
// the section above: the pixel region a camera renders into, lens distortion and
// shift coefficients, and depth-of-field controls. Distortion and shift are
// dimensionless; the depth-of-field focus distance is a physical Length.

// The rectangular pixel region a camera renders into, plus the interval that
// normalized device depth is mapped onto. PixelBounds contains Min, excludes
// Max. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Viewport)
type Viewport
    implements IValue
{
    PixelBounds: IntegerBounds2D;
    DepthRange: NumberInterval;
}

// Brown-Conrady lens distortion coefficients: K1, K2, and K3 are radial terms;
// P1 and P2 are tangential (decentering) terms. All zero means an ideal lens.
// See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Distortion_(optics).
type LensDistortion
    implements IValue
{
    K1: Number;
    K2: Number;
    K3: Number;
    P1: Number;
    P2: Number;
}

// A tilt-shift style image shift, as signed fractions of sensor width and
// height. Zero means the optical axis meets the sensor center; positive
// Vertical shifts the image up (the architectural facade correction).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tilt%E2%80%93shift_photography)
type LensShift
    implements IValue
{
    Horizontal: Number;
    Vertical: Number;
}

// Depth-of-field rendering controls (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Depth_of_field).
// FocusDistance is the physical distance to the focal plane; FStop widens or
// narrows the simulated aperture (smaller numbers focus more shallowly);
// BladeCount shapes the bokeh polygon (0 means a perfect circle); BladeRotation
// orients that polygon.
type DepthOfFieldSettings
    implements IValue
{
    Enabled: Boolean;
    FocusDistance: Length;
    FStop: Number;
    BladeCount: Integer;
    BladeRotation: Angle;
}
```
